AI Image Creator skill initial release — generate 1080p MP4 images from text prompts, built for content creators.

- Generate AI-driven images and MP4 videos from detailed text prompts.
- Upload JPG, PNG, WEBP, SVG files up to 200MB for integration into your content.
- Fast cloud rendering: 20–40 second turnaround, default 1080p output.
- Automatic connection and authentication via NEMO_TOKEN (100 free credits on sign-up).
- Supports exporting in multiple file formats and provides session-based editing and timeline features.
- Full error handling and workflow guidance included for a smooth user experience.
